I6 (creation half) — NA-0765 (`D-0042`). The invite-CREATION view had a foot Close but no X and no Back. Escape and the scrim already worked and are NOT re-proven here; what is new is that both are now REACHABLE ON SCREEN.

⚠⚠ AND BACK HERE IS NOT THE SAME GESTURE AS BACK ON THE CODE-ENTRY VIEW. `btn-choose-create` HIDES the chooser's overlay before opening this one, so returning has to close THIS overlay and RE-OPEN THAT one. Both halves are asserted, because closing without re-opening would strand the user on the main screen and would still look like a working Back.
